content_sections.heading: About GMRC
content_sections.text: Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation (GMRC) Limited is a 50:50 Special Purpose Vehicle jointly owned by the Government of India and the Government of Gujarat. It is entrusted with the implementation of the Ahmedabad Metro Rail Project and the Surat Metro Rail Project and with their operations and maintenance. This is a recruitment by a government-owned company, on contract, deputation or post-superannuation terms.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 13 vacancies in total. It states that the number of posts may vary based on further assessment of requirements. No category-wise break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Every post needs a degree from a Govt. recognized University/Institute and post-qualification executive experience. The table gives the educational qualification and the preferences; experience, age and current-pay conditions follow post by post. Age limits and experience are reckoned as on 3 November 2026. For all posts, the notice gives preference to candidates who have worked in Gujarat State for at least 3 years and are conversant with the Gujarati language. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay for each post is the revised IDA scale shown in the vacancy table. For deputation, pay is as per standard terms and conditions. Deputy General Manager posts on post-superannuation basis carry a consolidated pay of ₹ 1,00,000 per month. Engagement is for a minimum of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance, subject to the organisation's standard terms and conditions. For IDA/CDA scale employees, the percentage of HRA may vary according to the place of posting, as per Government guidelines and company policy. Other benefits are paid as per Company Policy. Selected candidates get Group medical coverage and Group personal accident insurance coverage as per GMRCL policies. Selected candidates are likely to be posted at Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat or any other project of GMRC anywhere in Gujarat.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications are accepted, through the "Careers" section of http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com . The online form can be edited before submission but not after it is submitted. Register on the portal with basic details such as name, DOB, category, mobile number and email ID. Log in with the credentials; the passcode is sent to the email ID given at registration. Select the position for which you are applying. Fill in the online application with relevant details, latest to earliest, and complete the form. Check the entered details with the "preview" option. Submit the form after verifying all the information, on or before 18 November 2026. Detailed curriculum vitae. Proof of age: Matriculation/Birth Certificate. Educational qualification: SSC marksheet, HSC marksheets, graduation all year/semester marksheets and degree/diploma certificates. Experience: experience/service certificates of past employments showing date of joining, date of relieving and department, along with pay details clearly mentioning payscale/CTC. Private-sector candidates: copy of the latest CTC break-up with the other documents at the time of online application. Without the CTC break-up the application will not be considered. Form-16 is used to arrive at the current CTC. Current organisation: appointment letter, proof of date of joining, latest payslip and Form-16 of the last three years.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection comprises Personal Interviews, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination as per the category prescribed for the post. The process judges knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude and physical fitness. Call letters with time, date and venue are issued to shortlisted applicants through registered email. The venue, date and time of interview will be informed in advance; no interview date is printed in the notice. Document verification is done before the interview. Candidates must carry original certificates, otherwise they will not be allowed to attend the interview. Photocopies are to be submitted with the resume at the interview. Preference goes to candidates with experience in the same grade or the immediate lower grade with 2 years' experience in the grade. If enough suitable candidates are not available, candidates from a lower pay scale who meet the prescribed qualifications, total experience and age criteria may be considered. A request to change the date or venue of the interview will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies: Deputy General Manager (Civil-Safety) 2, Deputy General Manager (Civil - QA/QC) 1, Assistant Manager (Civil-Safety) 4, Assistant Manager (Civil-QA/QC) 1, Section Engineer (Civil-Safety) 2, Section Engineer (Civil-QA/QC) 1, Engineer – Sr. Grade (M&P) 1 and Engineer – Jr. Grade (Signalling) 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GMRC posts?
faq.answer: Qualification depends on the post. Civil QA/QC posts need B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering; safety posts need an engineering degree in Civil/Mechanical/Electrical along with a minimum one-year full-time diploma in (Industrial) Safety; the Engineer posts need B.E/B.Tech in the disciplines listed for them. Experience is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age as on 3 November 2026 is 45 years (contract), 57 years (deputation) or 62 years (post-superannuation) for Deputy General Manager; 35 years for Assistant Manager; and 32 years for Section Engineer and both Engineer posts. The age limit does not apply to GMRCL employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for GMRC posts?
faq.answer: Pay is in the revised IDA scale: ₹ 70000-200000 for Deputy General Manager, ₹ 50000-160000 for Assistant Manager, 40000-140000 for Section Engineer, ₹35000-110000 for Engineer – Sr. Grade and ₹30000-120000 for Engineer – Jr. Grade. Deputy General Manager on post-superannuation basis gets consolidated pay of ₹ 1,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the "Careers" section of http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com. The notice states that no other mode of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for GMRC posts?
faq.answer: Selection is by Personal Interview, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination. Shortlisted applicants receive interview call letters by registered email.

faq.question: Q8. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on Contract/Deputation basis (Deputy General Manager also on post-superannuation basis) for a minimum of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired employees apply, and what will they be paid?
faq.answer: Retired officials can apply for Deputy General Manager on post-superannuation basis, if they retired from IDA pay scale ₹ 70000-200000 or above or Pay Level 10 or equivalent. The age limit is 62 years and the consolidated pay is ₹ 1,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q10. What do private-sector candidates need to submit?
faq.answer: Private-sector candidates must attach their latest CTC break-up at the time of online application, or the application will not be considered. The minimum CTC is ₹ 1,00,000 per month for Deputy General Manager, ₹ 70,000 for Assistant Manager and ₹ 50,000 for Section Engineer.
